items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I'll just mention players that I liked who played with you... Jaki Byard... He rounded the whole band out.

ctx.x: Yeah, at the Bohemia, yeah. I always liked -- I'll just mention players that I liked who played with you, and I thought the piano player from Boston, Jaki Byard.
Oh, yeah. I forgot about Jackie. I would say Jaki, too. He was well rounded. He rounded the whole band out.
